text.en:
The unexpended balance of the funds appropriated under Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred
and works, twenty-seven, paragraph F (bb), item (1), for the maintenance, extension, and protection of the
dykes of Agno River is hereby reappropriated for the construction, extension, maintenance, and protection of
the Agno River Control Works, Province of Pangasinan.

The funds appropriated in the preceding section shall be available for immediate expenditure by
the Director of Public Works.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 5, 1931.
